scope: GTK clipboard delivery/readback and enum CSV parser recovery
assertions: GDK clipboard readback exactly matches generated CSV text.
CSV parser recovery preserves literal NULL, empty text, SQL NULL, \N, and \NN with a collision-free null marker.
Formula-shaped text is sanitized to apostrophe-prefixed text and is not a lossless restore case.
remaining: Paste behavior in external spreadsheet applications is unverified.
Lossless restoration of formula-shaped text is not supported by this safety-prefixed path.
environment_note: GTK runner emitted a MESA DRI3 acceleration warning under the isolated display; all registered tests passed.
